spec.name: Furniture Tall Planter
spec.description: A tall indoor sapling with an asymmetric, tiered leafy crown, branching warm oak stems, and a substantial cream ceramic planter. Connected, axis-aligned furniture geometry with a recessed soil surface, raised pottery lip, and subtle foot. Front faces negative Z; all geometry stays within the requested margins.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: tall indoor leafy sapling in cream ceramic planter. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
